# IDOSI Journals

> International Digital Organization for Scientific Information (IDOSI) publishes peer-reviewed academic journals across disciplines including medical sciences, animal diseases, pharmacology, and mathematics with global editorial boards.

IDOSI Journals maintains multiple scientific databases and provides comprehensive submission guidelines, editorial standards, and publication ethics for researchers worldwide. The organization operates journals covering diverse fields from veterinary medicine to computational sciences with contributors from Africa, Middle East, and Asia.

- [About Us ... IDOSI Journals](https://idosi.org/AboutUs.htm): Overview of International Digital Organization for Scientific Information and IDOSI Journals

## Author Guidelines & Submission

- [IDOSI Journals Instructions to Authors](https://idosi.org/instructions.htm): Manuscript formatting and submission guidelines for IDOSI Journals authors
- [IDOSI Journals Special Issues](https://idosi.org/spissues.htm): Guidelines for submitting conference papers and special issues to IDOSI Journals
- [IDOSI Journals Publication Ethics](https://idosi.org/publicationsEthics.htm): Publication ethics standards and plagiarism policies for IDOSI Journals

## Journal Databases & Archives

- [IDOSI Journals Databases](https://idosi.org/dbases.htm): Directory of IDOSI scientific databases including IAD and Eur-Asia Database
- [Computational and Applied Mathematical Sciences (CAMS) On-line Available Now !!](https://idosi.org/cams/online.htm): Online archive and volumes of Computational and Applied Mathematical Sciences journal

## Journal Information & Editorial Boards

- [World Journal of Medical Sciences (WJMS) Aims & Scope](https://idosi.org/wjms/wjmsas.htm): Aims, scope, and publication policy for World Journal of Medical Sciences
- [World Journal of Sport Sciences (WJSS) Editorial Board](https://idosi.org/wjss/board.htm): Editorial board members for World Journal of Sport Sciences
- [Global Journal of Pharmacology (GJP) Editorial Board](https://idosi.org/gjp/board.htm): Editorial board members for Global Journal of Pharmacology

## Journal Issues & Research

- [Academic Journal of Animal Diseases (AJAD) Volume 11 Number (2), 2022](https://idosi.org/ajad/ajad11(2)2022.htm): Journal issue featuring peer-reviewed research on animal diseases and brucellosis
- [Academic Journal of Animal Diseases (AJAD) Volume 9 Number (2), 2020](https://idosi.org/ajad/ajad9(2)2020.htm): Journal issue with veterinary research on bovine diseases and livestock health in Ethiopia
